report_text:
ReDoS in left-pad 1.3.0.

    The padding routine uses a backtracking regular expression internally,
    so a crafted pad string of length ~100k characters blocks the event
    loop for minutes. We saw a production incident on a service that pads
    user nicknames with left-pad.

    Expected effect: padding the crafted string takes superlinear time on
    1.3.0; the project claims a fix in 1.4.0 but we could not find one.
source_note:
